author: test-reviewer

findings.description: Test method name `processFindFormWithPageBelowOneShowsFirstPage` names the production method rather than the behavior. The BDD naming school (testing-principles.md § Test Naming, applies from 2026-07-31 onward) requires `the{Subject}Should{Outcome}` — a name that survives renaming the production method.

The test asserts HTTP 200 and view name but never verifies that the model attribute `currentPage` is 1. The test name claims the first page is shown, but a regression that returned page 0 data (or any page number other than 1) with a 200 would not be caught. The production fix normalises `page < 1` to 1 and stores it as `currentPage`; that specific outcome is what the test should pin.

No test covers negative page values (e.g. `page=-1`). The production guard normalises all `page < 1` to 1, so the boundary is `page <= 0`, not just `page == 0`. The fix covers only one specific sub-boundary value while the production predicate is a range.
findings.fix: Add a `@ParameterizedTest` (or a second test method) covering `page=-1` alongside `page=0` to exercise the full `page < 1` range.

findings.description: Local variable `tasks` is a meaningless name for `Page<Owner>`. Testing-principles.md § Three-Tier Data Naming Convention requires role-describing names (Tier 1) for values that affect the outcome. The page content affects which branch executes (multiple owners → list view).

No blank line separates the Arrange phase (lines 153-154, mock stub setup) from the Act+Assert phase (line 155). Testing-principles.md § Four-Phase Test Structure requires phases to be separated by blank lines.
findings.fix: Insert a blank line between the `when(...)` stub line and the `mockMvc.perform(...)` line.
